# CVS feature

Packaging: `eclipse-feature`. The optional CVS integration groups CVS core and UI bundles and requires the base eReviewBoard feature and Eclipse CVS feature. The [feature descriptor](../../org.review_board.ereviewboard.cvs/feature.xml) defines the included bundles and version requirements; the [update site](../org.review_board.ereviewboard.update/overview.md) distributes it. There is no Java implementation in the feature module.

See [CVS core](../org.review_board.ereviewboard.cvs.core/overview.md) for base-file lookup and [CVS UI](../org.review_board.ereviewboard.cvs.ui/overview.md) for contribution wiring.
